description: Source code for a widget class 'wgMeasurement' that provides graphical measurement tools (points, angles, polygons, polylines) within a media viewer application, including functions for drawing, event handling, measurement management, and file saving.

classes.name: wgMeasurement
classes.description: A QDialog widget for performing and managing geometric measurements (points, angles, polygons, polylines) on media frames, with capabilities for drawing, saving, and editing measurements.

methods.name: show_widget
methods.description: Activates and displays the geometric measurement widget, setting up signal connections and initializing the widget.

methods.name: draw_point
methods.description: Draws a point marker on the current frame's image at specified coordinates with a given color.

methods.name: draw_line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points on the current frame's image with a specified color.

methods.name: append_results
methods.description: Appends a measurement result as a new row in the measurements table.

methods.name: image_clicked
methods.description: Handles mouse click events on the image to create measurements (points, angles, polygons, polylines) based on user interaction.
